name: WittyEbook
summary: Reflowable books (EPUB) with book view, typography and study tools.
updates: The EPUB reader itself: book view, typography, study tools, handwriting and its look.
stays: The Reader page, the ReaderHost it provides (saving your place and notes, fetching chapters), how the server takes a book apart and cleans it, and React stay with the server. If this bundle fails, the copy in the app takes over.
